title: Header Settings
description: Global header elements shown on every page. For the navigation menu itself, use Appearance > Menus.

fields.label: Logo image
fields.name: header_logo
fields.instructions: Optional. PNG with transparent background works best. Should read clearly on both a light hero overlay and a white scrolled header. Leave blank to use the Brand text instead.

fields.label: Logo height (px)
fields.name: header_logo_height
fields.instructions: Rendered height of the logo in the header.

fields.label: Brand text
fields.name: header_brand_text
fields.instructions: Shown in place of the logo when no image is uploaded. Also used as the logo's alt text when an image is set.
